idea-plugin.name: Nordic
idea-plugin.description:
A port of nordic.nvim (default options) for RustRover and CLion, with Rust and C/C++ highlighting mapped from what Neovim actually renders with treesitter and rust-analyzer / clangd semantic tokens.
  • Nordic editor color scheme (Settings | Editor | Color Scheme)
  • Nordic Islands UI theme (Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Appearance)
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.1.0: CLion support: every C/C++ key (CLion Nova and Classic) mapped from Neovim's treesitter + clangd rendering, plus CMake.
1.0.0: first release: Nordic editor color scheme (every Rust key mapped from Neovim's treesitter + rust-analyzer rendering, plus TOML, Markdown, JSON, YAML, console and diagnostics) and the Nordic Islands UI theme.
